had I not thrust them upward to enchant your senses with a grand spectacle? In the days when my parents, Night and 卡俄斯, prevailed, I was strong and made no secret of it. Playing boyhood games with the Titans, we tossed around 珀利翁山 and 奥萨山 like so many balls; until finally, tired of our youthful exuberance, as a prank, we wickedly tossed the two mountains on top of Parnassus, giving it a twin-peaked cap. 阿波罗, now, likes nothing so much as dwelling there with the choir of bless¢d Muses. And who but I fashioned and thrust on high the throne for 宙斯 and his thunderbolts? So here I am again, thrusting with unspeakable strength out of the abyss, welcoming all who will to begin a new life and settle on the new land that is me!

@@U03345@@
Had we not seen with our own eyes this mountain squeezed from the earth, wed say it was old as time. It’s rocks are still on the rise, pushing into place, and a forest is growing its way up the slope. But that means nothing to us 斯芬克斯们. We sit enthroned on our sacred site, and nothing disturbs us.

@@U03347@@
We see golden foil and nuggets quivering, gleaming through a million crannies. Emmets, this is no treasure to lose! Get busy there and dig out your hoard!
translation:
@@U03343@@
我不是把它们向上推，用壮观的景象迷惑你的感官吗？在我的父母奈特和卡俄斯占上风的日子里，我很坚强，毫不掩饰这一点。童年时，我们和泰坦们一起玩游戏，我们像很多球一样在珀利翁山和奥萨山上抛来滚去；直到最后，我们厌倦了青春的朝气，恶作剧般地将两座山扔到了帕纳塞斯山顶上，给它戴上了双峰帽。 现在，阿波罗最喜欢和缪斯女神的合唱团一起住在那里。除了我之外，还有谁为宙斯和他的雷电打造并推上了王座呢？于是我再次来到这里，以难以言表的力量从深渊中冲出来，欢迎所有愿意开始新生活、定居在我这片新土地上的人！

@@U03345@@
如果我们没有亲眼目睹这座山从大地中挤出来，我们就会说它已经很古老了。它的岩石仍在上升，推入到位，森林正在沿着斜坡生长。但这对我们斯芬克斯人来说毫无意义。我们坐在我们的圣地上，没有任何事情打扰我们。

@@U03347@@
我们看到金箔和金块在颤动，透过一百万个缝隙闪闪发光。埃米特斯，这不是一个可以失去的宝藏！在那里忙起来，挖出你的宝藏！
